registered_before: any score of the gate on LID-DS 2021 or CB-DS. The gate was found on trials of pulse-live-v4-1109 with attack labels (validation-evidence/results-20261109/benign-burden-research/), so that run is development for it
owner_decision: 09/11: improve benign-binary flagging and alert burden of lidds-ml-v4; both the cluster side and the ML system may change; keeping the v4 result on LID-DS 2021 has top priority, and any direction reaching an acceptable level is run again on LID-DS 2021

findings.benign: every benign alert window of the token branch holds the fixture's getpid + clock_nanosleep loop or the launch burst; about half of the benign intervals fire only within 1 s of the launch
findings.burden: in a sample of two segments 89 of 105 token episodes come from Kafka file maintenance (fsync, rename, unlink); the count branches add mostly Postgres support episodes
findings.count_branches: on pulse-live-v4-1109 so far and on LID-DS official they add no detection to the token branch and add false alarms (official 36 against 26), which reopens the 05/11 decision to keep them
findings.alert_path: trigger_kind dropped every token row in pulse-live-v4-1109, so token alarms reached neither Alertmanager nor RCA; fixed in sentinel_pulse/rca/tree.py and the worker

gate.pool_model: sum of the gram counts of all workloads (cluster) or of all scenarios and CB-DS (datasets), same language model as the token branch
gate.rule: a token alarm also needs the window's pool score above its pool threshold, and the window more than hold seconds after the container's or recording's last execve
gate.pool_threshold: normal only: moment Gumbel without the top 1 % of the maxima outside the hold (60 s blocks per container on the cluster, recordings on datasets), at the candidate's pool level

system: token branch alone, tree and support logged in shadow

selection.step_1_keep_lidds: LID-DS development and CB-DS only: detected >= 530/544, false alarms <= 12/3403, p95 <= 1.52 s, CB-DS 891/891, false alarms <= 3/1410 (the lidds-ml-v4 numbers); the scorer must reproduce them without a gate first
selection.step_2_cluster: among the candidates of step 1, on the trials of pulse-live-v4-1109: primary recall >= 95 %, then lowest benign flag rate, then fewest normal episodes, then the simpler candidate
selection.step_3_official: one candidate, by scripts/analysis/lidds_ml_v5.py --official: detected >= 1238/1271, false alarms <= 36/7938, p95 <= 1.5 s. If it fails, no other gate is tried on official and the gate is dropped

live.run: pulse-live-v5-<MMDD>, only after pulse-live-v4-1109 has finished its full cycle and step 3 has passed; the normal capture pulse-token-capture-1107 is reused, the fit is token_branch_fit.py --folds 5 --fold-seconds 1800 --share 0.9 --pool-level L --exec-hold H
live.controls: each trial also runs one real admin command through kubectl exec (ls, cat, ps, env, id, sh, python3, date, uname, df in turn); commands the image lacks are left out. No choice of the gate has seen them, and they are reported apart from the benign binary
live.acceptable: primary recall >= 95 %, precision >= 95 %, idle control <= 5 %, p95 <= 3 s, benign binary and admin commands each <= 20 % (exec-intent-v1), burden <= 1.76 episodes per replica-hour (pulse-final-system-confirm)

limits: the exec hold hides a short command that finishes within the hold, and an attacker can exec repeatedly to stay held; the raw alarm stays in the decision row
slow attacks (1 and 3 per second) lose recall in the simulation on pulse-live-v4-1109
the benign binary and the attacks come from one fixture, hence the admin commands
code: sentinel_pulse/detector/token_model.py (TokenBranch gate), sentinel_pulse/detector/v3_policy.py (shadow), scripts/analysis/token_branch_fit.py, count_branch_fit.py --shadow, lidds_ml_token_pool.py, lidds_ml_v5.py, pulse_live_v4.py, sentinel_pulse/attack/preview_campaign.py (admin control)
